llm.summary: The skill is a planning aid, but it explicitly chains into an execution phase without asking the user first.

dimensions.detail: Planning instructions and writing `docs/implementation-plan.md` are proportionate, but automatic handoff to execution may cause later file changes or commands outside the planning-only expectation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable `SKILL.md` with normal skill metadata and no install scripts, hooks, package code, or hidden files found in the artifact directory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The continuation behavior is disclosed, but the instruction says not to prompt for confirmation before entering execution; only a `--standalone` flag or an explicit stop request prevents it.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, credential access, background worker, network call, privilege escalation, or local indexing behavior is present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is project planning and task breakdown, but the artifact requires auto-invoking `Skill(attune:project-execution)` after saving the plan, which moves beyond planning into likely action-taking.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you expect planning to stop after producing a plan. Use `--standalone` or explicitly tell the agent to stop after planning, because the skill otherwise instructs the agent to proceed directly into the execution phase.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifact itself requires automatic transition from planning to execution once the implementation plan is saved, which exceeds a planning skill's normal boundary.
[EA2] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifact explicitly suppresses a confirmation prompt before the execution phase, although it does disclose bypass conditions.
